svg.metadata: {"title":"Relink queue: short locks","speed":2000,"elements":[{"id":"root","type":"group","children":["writers","queue","worker"],"layout":{"direction":"row","gap":64,"align":"center"}},{"id":"writers","type":"group","label":{"title":"Same bank"},"children":["a","b"],"layout":{"direction":"column","gap":28,"align":"stretch"}},{"id":"a","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Retain A"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"long transaction"}]},{"id":"b","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Edit B"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"touches unit u7"}]},{"id":"queue","type":"cylinder","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Relink queue"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"graph_maintenance_queue"}]},{"id":"worker","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Relink worker"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"50 units per batch"}]},{"id":"a_q","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"a"},"end":{"id":"queue"},"label":{"text":"at commit"}},{"id":"b_q","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"b"},"end":{"id":"queue"},"label":{"text":"at commit"}},{"id":"claim","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"queue"},"end":{"id":"worker"},"label":{"text":"claim"}}],"scenes":[{"label":"Writers","beats":[{"light":["a"],"show":{"a":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"gray","text":"needs relink","meta":"held in memory"}]},"say":"Retain A changes unit u7. It notes the unit, but does not touch the queue yet."},{"edges":"b_q","show":{"queue":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"blue","text":"queued","mark":"new"}]},"say":"Edit B also touches u7 and commits. No lock of A's is in its way."},{"edges":"a_q","ms":2600,"show":{"queue":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"blue","text":"queued","meta":"one row"}]},"say":"A queues u7 as its last step before commit: the row lock lasts milliseconds."}]},{"label":"Worker","beats":[{"edges":"claim","show":{"queue":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"orange","text":"claimed","meta":"stamped"}]},"say":"The worker stamps the batch in a short transaction of its own, then relinks."},{"edges":"b_q","show":{"queue":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"blue","text":"queued","meta":"stamp cleared","mark":"↻"}]},"say":"An edit to u7 lands mid-relink: re-queuing clears the stamp, without waiting."},{"light":["worker"],"ms":2800,"show":{"queue":[{"tag":"u7","tone":"blue","text":"still queued","mark":"✓"}]},"say":"The worker deletes only rows still carrying its stamp, so u7 gets another pass."}]}]}
